works.idea_zh: 我们对机器人的不安也许是代际的；与机械臂一起长大的孩子可能把它当家人，而不是威胁。
works.method: Design fiction built around a small industrial robot arm, with functional prototypes, staged photographs and an illustrated book (HfG Schwäbisch Gmünd student project).
works.method_zh: 围绕一台小型工业机械臂展开的设计虚构，包括可用原型、布景摄影和一本插画书（施瓦本格明德设计学院学生项目）。
exhibited: Hello, Robot., Vitra Design Museum 2017 (and tour)

works.title: LoveLetters_1.0
works.description: A working replica of the Ferranti Mark 1 runs Christopher Strachey's 1952 love-letter program; its letters, signed 'M.U.C.' (Manchester University Computer), are projected in public space.
works.description_zh: 一台可运行的 Ferranti Mark 1 复制机执行 Christopher Strachey 1952 年的情书程序；这些署名“M.U.C.”（曼彻斯特大学计算机）的情书被投影到公共空间。
works.idea_en: The first text a computer generated for pleasure was a love letter; machine language began as simulated feeling.
works.idea_zh: 计算机最早为消遣而生成的文本是情书；机器语言从模拟情感开始。
works.method: Physical replica of the Mark 1 console driven by an emulator running Strachey's original code with the machine's random-number generator.
works.method_zh: Mark 1 控制台的实体复制品，由仿真器运行 Strachey 的原始代码与机器自带的随机数发生器。
exhibited: The Imitation Game, Manchester Art Gallery 2016

works.title: ORLAN-OÏDE
works.description: A humanoid robot double of the artist, with her face and voice, that answers questions and speaks about art; ORLAN has interviewed it in public.
works.description_zh: 艺术家的人形机器人分身，拥有她的面孔与声音，能回答问题、谈论艺术；ORLAN 曾在公开场合与它对谈。
works.idea_en: An artist famous for remaking her body builds a machine self and lets it speak in her place.
works.idea_zh: 一位以改造自身身体闻名的艺术家，造出机器自我并让它代替自己说话。
works.method: Robotic bust with a conversational AI trained on the artist's texts and a synthesised copy of her voice; later versions developed with RaspiAudio.
works.method_zh: 机器人半身像，搭载以艺术家文本训练的对话 AI 和合成的本人声音；后续版本与 RaspiAudio 合作开发。

works.title: Les Injonctions
works.description: A small electromechanical puppet with a human body and a mouse's head tries to teach the rudiments of speech to an artificial larynx, alternating orders and encouragement like a teacher with a slow pupil.
works.description_zh: 一个人身鼠头的小型机电木偶，试图教会一个人造喉咙说话的基本功，像老师对待迟钝的学生一样，时而下命令，时而鼓励。
works.idea_en: Machine learning staged as schooling: one machine drilling another, with all the patience and cruelty of education.
works.idea_zh: 把机器学习演成上学：一台机器操练另一台，带着教育里全部的耐心与残酷。
works.method: Automaton with motorised head and arms and a mechanical vocal tract producing speech-like sounds, run by a programmed sequence.
works.method_zh: 头部与手臂由电机驱动的自动机，加上发出类似语音声音的机械声道，由预设程序控制。

works.title: Tickle Salon
works.description: A visitor lies on a bed while a hanging robot strokes their skin with a soft brush; it gradually maps the shape of the body and its caresses become finer and smoother.
works.description_zh: 观众躺在床上，一个悬挂的机器人用柔软的刷子抚过其皮肤；它逐步描绘出身体的形状，抚触也越来越细腻顺滑。
works.idea_en: A machine never tires of attention; its care is learned from the surface of the body it touches.
works.idea_zh: 机器的专注从不疲倦；它的照护是从所触碰身体的表面学来的。
works.method: Cable-suspended robot with a feeler that scans the skin surface and builds a 3D body model; the Robot Love version added EEG feedback to adapt the strokes.
works.method_zh: 由缆绳悬挂的机器人带有探头，扫描皮肤表面并建立身体三维模型；在 Robot Love 展出的版本加入脑电反馈来调整抚触。
exhibited: Pioneers of Change, Governors Island, New York 2009

works.title: Annelies, Looking for Completion
works.description: A lifelike android clone of the twin artists, a 'third sister', sits crying in a corner; when visitors try to comfort her she looks up with a tear-streaked face.
works.description_zh: 一个按双胞胎艺术家本人制作的逼真仿人机器人，“第三个姐妹”，坐在角落里哭泣；观众试图安慰她时，她抬起满是泪痕的脸看着对方。
works.idea_en: Instead of a robot that serves us, a robot that needs us, and the discomfort of comforting a machine.
works.idea_zh: 不是为我们服务的机器人，而是需要我们的机器人，以及安慰一台机器时的那种不自在。
works.method: Silicone android modelled on the artists' faces and bodies, with motorised facial expressions, tear mechanism and sensors reacting to approach.
works.method_zh: 按艺术家面部与身体制作的硅胶仿人机器人，带电动表情、流泪装置和感应观众靠近的传感器。

works.title: Metamorphism
works.description: Motherboards, hard drives, CPUs and memory from laptops and phones melted in artificial lava into polychrome stones, shown in vitrines like specimens from a future natural history museum.
works.description_zh: 把笔记本电脑和手机里的主板、硬盘、CPU 和内存在人造熔岩中熔化成多彩的石头，放在展柜里，如同未来自然史博物馆的标本。
works.idea_en: Computers return to rock: the 'immaterial' digital is a geological body borrowed from the earth.
works.idea_zh: 电脑重新变回岩石：所谓“非物质”的数字，其实是向地球借来的地质之躯。
works.method: E-waste components mixed with rock and fused in a furnace at lava temperatures, then cut and displayed.
works.method_zh: 把电子废料部件与岩石混合，在熔岩温度的炉中熔融，再切割展示。
exhibited: Into the Hollow, Dittrich & Schlechtriem, Berlin 2016
The World Through AI, Jeu de Paume, Paris 2025

works.title: The Man Machine
works.description: A photographic series of real humanoid robots, including ASIMO and REEM-B, posed in laboratories, homes and landscapes with the stillness of formal portraits.
works.description_zh: 一组真实人形机器人的摄影系列，包括 ASIMO 和 REEM-B，它们在实验室、住宅与风景中以正式肖像般的静止姿态出现。
works.idea_en: Portraiture, a genre for persons, applied to machines makes us ask what in them looks back.
works.idea_zh: 把为人而设的肖像体裁用在机器身上，让我们追问它们身上是什么在回望。
works.method: Staged large-format colour photographs made on location with robotics labs in Japan, Europe and the US.
works.method_zh: 在日本、欧洲和美国的机器人实验室实地拍摄的布景式大画幅彩色照片。

works.title: manifest
works.description: An industrial robot at a desk writes manifestos with a pen, one unique numbered sheet after another, cuts each off the roll and lets it fall to the floor for visitors to take.
works.description_zh: 一台工业机器人坐在书桌前用笔书写宣言，一张接一张、每张编号且独一无二，写完便从纸卷上裁下，任其落地供观众取走。
works.idea_en: A robot avant-garde: a machine without morals drafts the laws of a future human–machine society.
works.idea_zh: 机器人先锋派：一台没有道德的机器为未来的人机社会起草法律。
works.method: A KUKA-type industrial arm combines terms from philosophy, art theory, ethics and law with sentence structures from historical manifestos (2017 version: legal texts) and writes the results by hand.
works.method_zh: 一台 KUKA 类工业机械臂把哲学、艺术理论、伦理与法律术语，与历史宣言的句式（2017 年版本为法律文本）组合，再亲手写下。

works.title: Surveillance Paparazzi
works.description: A machine that watches unsecured surveillance cameras around the world and uses face recognition to 'snap' celebrities who happen to pass, like an automated paparazzo.
works.description_zh: 一台机器监看全球不设防的监控摄像头，用人脸识别“抓拍”恰好经过的名人，像一个自动化的狗仔。
works.idea_en: Paparazzi work can now be done by any open camera plus a classifier; everyone is filmed, only some are recognised.
works.idea_zh: 狗仔的工作如今只需一个开放摄像头加一个分类器；人人都被拍摄，只有部分人被认出。
works.method: Scrapes live feeds from publicly accessible, unencrypted CCTV cameras and runs a celebrity face-recognition model on them.
works.method_zh: 抓取可公开访问、未加密的监控摄像头实时画面，并在其上运行名人人脸识别模型。
